thesis: No entry. The account is flat, so there is nothing to manage and the only question is whether to open. This check builds on the 20:00 research note rather than repeating it: that note left two things to carry forward, and one hour of data has resolved both. First, ETHUSDT was the only contract with a real level overhead and failed at 1.34 net reward/risk on an honest stop, with the note stating that a pullback toward 2694-2700 would make the same trade work. The opposite happened. ETH advanced from a 2722.55 ask to 2739.52, which leaves 31.48 of reward to the unchanged 2771.00 target against 46.52 of risk to the unchanged 2693.00 structural stop: gross 0.68, net 0.55 after the 14 bps round-trip cost estimate of 3.8353. The single candidate the previous slot identified has moved further away from qualifying, not closer, and the condition that would have rescued it has not occurred. Second, the note asked for BTCUSDT to be watched for further artifacts. No new artifact printed this hour, but the 12:00Z BTC bar that was flagged in progress at 20:00 has now closed with its 2.97% upper wick against a 0.73% body intact, so it is a confirmed third artifact for the day alongside the 09:00Z BTC bar and the 09:00Z ETH bar. BTCUSDT therefore remains structurally unreadable and is excluded again on that basis, quite apart from having no daily high above the current price in 60 days. What is genuinely new this hour is XRPUSDT, and it is the trade that was worked through. At 20:00 XRP was trading at 1.4886 directly into the 1.4894 swing high of 2026-09-14 with the next level too far away, giving 0.89 net. It has since cleared 1.4894 and now trades at 1.4900, which for the first time today puts a contract in this complex below genuine overhead daily structure: 1.5270 on 2026-08-24, 1.5441 on 2026-08-25, 1.5444 on 2026-08-23 and 1.7000 on 2026-08-22. XRP is the laggard that never recovered to its August prices, which is why it has levels overhead while BTC, BNB and SOL sit at 60-day highs with nothing above them. The arithmetic works: entry 1.4900 at a 0.67 bps spread, a structural stop at 1.4700 below the 1.4710 and 1.4717 lows of the two hours that followed the breakout and comfortably below the broken 1.4894 level, and the 1.5270 target gives 0.0200 risk against 0.0370 reward, a net reward/risk of 1.58 after 0.002086 of cost. It is nevertheless rejected, and on the entry conditions rather than on a preference. The decisive failure is the requirement for at least two independent evidence categories supporting the same direction. Only trend and market_context support a long on XRP, and on a day when all five contracts rose 5.1% to 8.3% together on one 08:00Z impulse those two are the same observation counted twice. The strategy is explicit that these five contracts are five ways to express one view rather than five independent opportunities, and that evidence drawn over the same candles is one observation and not two. Volume does not merely fail to help, it argues the other way: XRP's breakout hour at 08:00Z traded 3,834,343,687 against 3,979,635,555 the hour before, so participation contracted on the move rather than expanding, and every hour since has been lower still, down to 3,445,568,944 at 12:00Z. Price action supplies no trigger either, because 1.4900 sits in the middle of a four-hour range of 1.4847 to 1.4969 rather than at a break and retest or a rejection at a level; the 20:00 note refused an ETH stop that was chosen for size rather than for invalidation, and the same discipline refuses an entry price chosen for convenience rather than for structure. Derivatives cannot carry the count either. Funding is at the 0.0100% baseline on XRP with the next funding at 16:00Z, which says only that longs are not crowded, and the demo host does not serve /futures/data/openInterestHist at all, so the change in open interest that would make this category informative is unmeasurable here and only the absolute snapshot is available. Two further points reinforce the rejection without being the reason for it. The 1.58 margin survives only at the tightest defensible stop, falling to 1.51 at a 1.4690 stop and 1.29 at 1.4650, so there is no room for worse slippage than assumed. And the check falls eighteen minutes before the 21:30 Asia/Kuala_Lumpur US open, which the strategy names as erratic, in an environment that has printed three multi-percent artifact wicks today; an exchange-side stop 1.34% below the entry triggers on the mark price in that same environment, and the strategy states plainly that an artifact can trigger a resting order. SOLUSDT made a new 24 hour and 60 day high at 117.31 in the ten minutes before this check on expanding five-minute volume and again has no daily high above it anywhere in 60 days, so it has no structural target and is rejected on the same ground as at 20:00. BNBUSDT at 792.17 is likewise above its 785.00 60-day high excluding today with nothing overhead. A short was reconsidered and rejected outright for the same reasons as at 20:00: it would trade against a clean uptrend on a 60-day-high breakout day with funding at or below baseline everywhere, meaning no crowded long positioning to squeeze. Extension is a reason to decline a long, not a reason to sell. LESSONS.md holds no lessons yet because the experiment has no closed trades, so no lesson applied; the guidance actually carried forward is the 20:00 research note's own, that the complex is extended into highs and that the reward/risk floor rejecting longs at these prices is the floor working rather than a problem to engineer around, and this decision is consistent with it.

This is not a break and retest, not a rejection at support and not a failed breakout, so there is no price action trigger at the current price. SOLUSDT by contrast printed a new 24h and 60d high of 117.31 in the 13:05Z 5m bar on 45,994 against 1,904 and 2,051 in the two bars before it. ETHUSDT has advanced to 2739.08 and holds above the broken 2700.00. Direction: neutral on XRP at this price; the levels that would give an XRP entry a trigger are 1.4969 above and 1.4847/1.4894 below.

XRPUSDT shows contraction, not expansion, through its entire move. Breakout hour 08:00Z traded 3,834,343,687 against 3,979,635,555 in the 07:00Z hour and 4,209,060,240 in the 06:00Z hour, then declined every hour since: 3,750,851,033 -> 3,792,001,698 -> 3,734,140,985 -> 3,445,568,944. The strategy defines this category as participation expanding on the move; XRP's does the opposite. Direction: argues against the XRP long. SOLUSDT remains the only contract with a genuine expansion signature (790,113 on the 08:00Z breakout hour against 206,989 the hour before, a 3.8x expansion, then a steady dry-up to 175,302), but SOL has no structural target.

Funding at or below the 0.010% baseline on every contract after a 5-8% day: BTCUSDT -0.00003772 (a long would receive), ETHUSDT 0.00001039, BNBUSDT 0.00000000, SOLUSDT 0.00010000, XRPUSDT 0.00010000. Next funding 2026-09-21T16:00Z for all five, about 2.8 hours out; a long on XRP or SOL would pay 0.01%. The demo host does not serve /futures/data/openInterestHist (empty response for every symbol), so the change in open interest is unmeasurable in this environment and only absolute snapshots are available: BTC 414,025,411.33, ETH 11,745,225,679.52, BNB 27,707,444,421.29, SOL 2,977,184,561.65, XRP 15,600,795,069,537.4. Direction: permissive rather than supportive. No crowded long positioning to fade argues against a short; it is not a positive reason to buy, and without an OI trend this category cannot be counted toward the two-category requirement.

All five up together over 24h, extending a further 0.2-1.0% in the hour since the 20:00 check: SOL +8.25% (was +7.21%), XRP +8.16% (was +7.57%), ETH +6.08% (was +5.57%), BTC +5.87% (was +5.74%), BNB +5.15% (was +4.93%). One complex-wide move rather than five independent setups. Direction: supports long, rules out short. This is also why trend and market_context cannot both be counted for XRP: XRP's uptrend today is this complex move.

considered_and_rejected.long_XRPUSDT: The only contract in the complex with genuine overhead daily structure, and the only candidate this slot that clears the arithmetic. Entry 1.4900 (ask, spread 0.67 bps), structural stop 1.4700 below the 1.4710 and 1.4717 lows of the 09:00Z and 10:00Z hours that followed the breakout and below the broken 1.4894 level of 2026-09-14, target 1.5270 (daily high of 2026-08-24). Gross risk 0.0200, gross reward 0.0370, round-trip cost estimate 0.002086 at 14 bps, net reward/risk 1.58. Rejected on the two-independent-evidence-category requirement, not on the reward/risk: the only categories supporting the direction are trend and market_context, which on a day when all five contracts moved 5-8% on one 08:00Z impulse are the same observation, while volume contracted rather than expanded on the breakout hour and has declined every hour since, price action offers no trigger at 1.4900 in the middle of a four-hour 1.4847-1.4969 range, and derivatives is permissive rather than supportive with OI change unmeasurable on this host. Secondary concerns, not the basis of the rejection: the 1.58 margin survives only at the tightest defensible stop (1.51 at a 1.4690 stop, 1.29 at 1.4650), and the check sits eighteen minutes before the 21:30 MYT US open in an environment that has printed three multi-percent artifact wicks today, with an exchange-side stop 1.34% away triggering on the mark price in that same environment.
considered_and_rejected.long_ETHUSDT: The 20:00 candidate, re-tested and now materially worse. Entry has risen from 2722.55 to 2739.52 while the structural stop at 2693.00 (beyond the 2694.94 post-breakout low and the broken 2700.00 level) and the 2771.00 target (2026-08-21 daily high) are unchanged. That is 46.52 risk against 31.48 reward, gross 0.68 and net 0.55 after a 3.8353 cost estimate, against 1.34 an hour ago. The pullback toward 2694-2700 that the 20:00 note said would make this trade work has not occurred; price moved the other way. Rejected.
considered_and_rejected.long_SOLUSDT: Best volume signature on the board again, and the only contract to make a new high in the minutes before this check (117.31 on the 13:05Z 5m bar, 45,994 against 1,904 and 2,051 in the preceding bars). Rejected on the same ground as at 20:00 and unchanged by the new high: SOL is at a 60-day high with no daily high above the current price anywhere in 60 days, so an honest stop below the 114.13 breakout level gives 3.41 of risk with no structural level to target. Any target would be invented to satisfy the 1.5 floor, which the strategy prohibits in the same way it prohibits choosing a stop to fit a size.
considered_and_rejected.long_BNBUSDT: Tightest spread on the board at 0.38 bps and trading at 792.17, above the 785.00 60-day high excluding today, with today's high at 794.67. No daily high above the current price in 60 days, therefore no structural target. Rejected unchanged from 20:00.
considered_and_rejected.long_BTCUSDT: Excluded under the Demo Price Artifacts rule. Two confirmed upside artifacts inside four hours, the second now closed rather than in progress, leave the recent highs and the 24h high field unreadable. Exchange-side stop and take-profit orders on this account trigger on the mark price in the same environment. Separately BTC is at a 60-day high with nothing overhead. Rejected.
considered_and_rejected.short_any: Reconsidered and rejected outright, unchanged from 20:00. A short would trade against a clean daily uptrend on the day of a 60-day-high breakout across the whole complex, with funding at or below baseline on all five contracts, meaning there is no crowded long positioning to squeeze. The bar for a short is the same two independent categories as for a long and no category supports the down direction. The only argument available is that the move is extended, and extension is a reason to decline a long, not a reason to sell.

lessons_applied: None available: 05-交易记录-data/reviews/LESSONS.md records no lessons yet because the experiment has no closed trades. The guidance actually carried forward is the 20:00 research note's own next-task focus, which named ETHUSDT as the contract to re-check first and asked for BTCUSDT to be declined while artifacts keep printing. Both were followed: ETH was re-tested and has deteriorated from 1.34 to 0.55 net reward/risk, and BTC was excluded on a third confirmed artifact. That note's closing point, that the reward/risk floor rejecting longs into extension is the floor working rather than a problem to engineer around, was applied to XRPUSDT in the one case where the floor did clear, by testing the evidence requirement honestly instead of treating a passing 1.58 as sufficient on its own.
